title: Mediated Studies In Respiratory Therapy V
description: Fifth of seven courses paralleling content taught in courses in the Respiratory Therapy Program. Designed to develop and reinforce concepts taught in the concurrent lecture and laboratory sessions of the program, with a focus on neonatal diseases, ECG, and hemodynamic monitoring. Media materials, simulations, and videos will provide alternative learning resources to accommodate diverse learning styles. Intended for students in the Respiratory Therapy Program; enrollment is limited to students accepted in the program.
outcomes: Identifies and chooses the correct laboratory tests that lead to proper treatment in the clinical simulation scenarios.
Student will be able to recognize hemodynamic waveforms.
objectives: The student will be able to describe and demonstrate the following skills:
content: Using neonatal airway graphics to optimize care in neonatal patients
Evolution of RC in the NICU to reduce the use of invasive ventilation
Mandatory minute ventilation in neonatal care
Volume targeted ventilation in neonatal care
